## Synopsis

```text
perch alias list [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

List the addresses and catch-all domains assigned to an account.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--account <value>` | account email |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch alias list --account you@example.com
```
